items.name: Ministry of Defence
items.description: Responsible for national defence, defence policy, and coordination of matters related to the Nepal Army.
items.descriptionNepali: राष्ट्रिय रक्षा, रक्षा नीति तथा नेपाली सेनासम्बन्धी कार्यहरूको समन्वय गर्ने मन्त्रालय।
items.keywords: defence army national security raksha mantralaya mod

items.name: Ministry of Finance
items.description: Responsible for economic policy, national budget, revenue, public finance, and government financial management.
items.keywords: finance economic budget revenue tax arth mantralaya mof

items.name: Ministry of Home Affairs
items.description: Responsible for internal security, public order, citizenship, disaster management, and related administrative security matters.
items.keywords: home affairs security police immigration disaster griha mantralaya moha

items.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
items.description: Responsible for Nepal's foreign relations, diplomacy, international cooperation, and matters concerning Nepali citizens abroad.
items.keywords: foreign affairs diplomacy passport treaty international pararashtra mantralaya mofa

items.name: Ministry of Health and Food Hygiene
items.description: Responsible for public health, healthcare services, food hygiene, and related policies and regulation.
items.keywords: health food hygiene hospital swasthya mohp

items.name: Ministry of Education and Sports
items.description: Responsible for education-system development and policies, development, and promotion of the sports sector.
items.descriptionNepali: शिक्षा प्रणालीको विकास तथा नीति, खेलकुद क्षेत्रको विकास र प्रवर्द्धनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने मन्त्रालय।

items.name: Ministry of Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation
items.description: Responsible for energy, water resources, hydropower, irrigation, and renewable-energy policy and development.
items.keywords: energy electricity hydropower water irrigation moewri urja

items.name: Ministry of Information and Communication
items.description: Responsible for policies, development, and regulation of information, communications, and mass media.
items.descriptionNepali: सूचना, सञ्चार तथा आमसञ्चार क्षेत्रको नीति, विकास र नियमनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने मन्त्रालय।
items.keywords: information communication media mass moic mantralaya

items.name: Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation
items.nepali: संस्कृति, पर्यटन तथा नागरिक उड्डयन मन्त्रालय
items.description: Responsible for cultural and heritage preservation, tourism development, and civil aviation policy and management.
items.keywords: tourism culture civil aviation airports heritage sanskriti tourism.gov.np

items.name: Ministry of Land Management, Cooperatives, Federal Affairs and General Administration
items.nepali: भूमि व्यवस्था, सहकारी, संघीय मामिला तथा सामान्य प्रशासन मन्त्रालय
items.description: Responsible for land management, cooperatives, federal affairs, local government, and public administration.
items.keywords: land management cooperatives federal affairs general administration mofaga sanghiya

items.name: Ministry of Infrastructure Development
items.description: Responsible for policies, planning, and coordination related to national physical infrastructure and development.
items.descriptionNepali: राष्ट्रिय भौतिक पूर्वाधार तथा विकाससम्बन्धी नीति, योजना र समन्वयको कार्य गर्ने मन्त्रालय।
items.keywords: infrastructure development roads construction purvadhara mantralaya mopid

items.name: Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs
items.nepali: कानून, न्याय तथा संसदीय मामिला मन्त्रालय
items.description: Responsible for legal drafting, legal advice, justice-related matters, and coordination of government affairs with the Federal Parliament.
items.descriptionNepali: कानून निर्माण, कानूनी सल्लाह, न्यायिक मामिला तथा संघीय संसद्सँग सम्बन्धित सरकारी कार्यको समन्वय गर्ने मन्त्रालय।
items.keywords: law justice parliamentary affairs legal moljpa mantralaya

items.name: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation
items.description: Responsible for government policies and programs supporting science, technology, research, and innovation.
items.descriptionNepali: विज्ञान, प्रविधि, अनुसन्धान तथा नवप्रवर्तनलाई समर्थन गर्ने सरकारी नीति तथा कार्यक्रम सञ्चालन गर्ने मन्त्रालय।
items.keywords: science technology innovation research mosti mantralaya

items.name: Ministry of Women, Children, Gender and Sexual Minorities and Social Security
items.nepali: महिला, बालबालिका, लैङ्गिक तथा यौनिक अल्पसंख्यक र सामाजिक सुरक्षा मन्त्रालय
items.description: Responsible for policies, protection, inclusion, empowerment, and social security concerning women, children, gender and sexual minorities.
items.descriptionNepali: महिला, बालबालिका, लैंगिक तथा यौनिक अल्पसंख्यक र सामाजिक सुरक्षासम्बन्धी नीति, संरक्षण, समावेशिता, सशक्तिकरणको कार्य गर्ने मन्त्रालय।
items.keywords: women children gender social security mowcsc mantralaya

items.name: Ministry of Agriculture, Forests and Environment
items.description: Responsible for agricultural development, forest conservation, and environmental policies, plans, and programs.
items.descriptionNepali: कृषि विकास, वन संरक्षण तथा वातावरणसम्बन्धी नीति, योजना र कार्यक्रम सञ्चालन गर्ने मन्त्रालय।

items.name: Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies
items.description: Responsible for industrial development, trade, commerce, and management of essential supplies.
items.descriptionNepali: औद्योगिक विकास, व्यापार, वाणिज्य तथा आवश्यक वस्तुको आपूर्ति व्यवस्थापन गर्ने मन्त्रालय।
items.keywords: industry commerce trade supplies udyog moics

items.name: Ministry of Youth, Labour and Employment
items.description: Responsible for youth development, labour, employment, and foreign-employment policies and programs.
items.descriptionNepali: युवा विकास, श्रम, रोजगार तथा विदेशी रोजगारसम्बन्धी नीति र कार्यक्रम सञ्चालन गर्ने मन्त्रालय।
items.keywords: youth labour employment foreign employment moless
